itemized.notes: Typed schedules, rotated landscape scan. The filer marks IN-KIND rows with a verbatim '(IN KIND)' tag written in the Address / Person column — 7 on Form A and 6 on Form B; those rows COUNT toward the printed schedule totals (the page's own arithmetic proves it), so `in_kind=True` here is a property of the row, not an exclusion.
